cost.network_during_build: git clone of the public repos named in the corpus

summary.reading: Each task is reduced by one question: does the test the commit added still fail when it is moved back onto the parent? Only those are fail-to-pass tasks. COLLECTION means the test needs the fix to import, so no solver can be measured on it, and PASS means it was never a bug.
summary.what_this_does_not_show: that any solver can solve the genuine tasks. This establishes the task set. The next object is the same list run against a solver.

why_this_lives_with_the_corpus: this is a manifest of which corpus entries are usable tasks, not a claim about the system. Placing it beside the corpus it describes keeps one artifact per question: the corpus says what the commits are, this says which of them can be tested, and the verification receipt says what the system did with the testable ones.
